text.content: Test whether making the final main action residual explicitly depend on same-slot object-local memory deltas, through both a raw-delta multiplicative gate and a learned directional residual, converts R4's identifiable object memory into causal full-policy use.

Focused tests and distributed BF16 GPU smoke pass; eight-B200 training completes 500 finite optimizer steps and saves a complete checkpoint; zero intervention gives exactly zero object-delta RMS, gate deviation, and directional residual RMS; slot absolute cosine remains below 0.95 and positive similarity exceeds both negative similarities by at least 0.05; on the identical held-out stream and seed, aligned-history main action loss is at least 1% lower than both zero and shuffled interventions. No 20k run unless every gate passes.

R4 competitive visual object memory plus same-slot latest-minus-previous object deltas; action-to-delta cross-attention; fixed raw-delta multiplicative gate scale 0.25; learned directional residual scale 0.25; R4 checkpoint warm start; train complete strong_action_expert; 500 steps; batch 64/rank; DP8; matched none/zero/shuffle validation.

RoboCasa365 B4 processed split plus 1,143,698-record triple-view Wan latent cache and episode-safe t-36/t-24/t-12 visual-history sidecar; same data, packing, and held-out stream as R4; no future lookup.
wam@208.64.254.190; pyrogpucompute1; cwam-b4-runtime:ngc25.09-ffmpeg6; /data0/wam/cwam-b4/env/cosmos-cu130; offline model assets.
Eight-rank R5 R4-warm probe with strong_action_expert optimizer scope, followed by exact-checkpoint validation-only none, zero, and shuffle cells on the same held-out stream.
pyrogpucompute1; 8 x NVIDIA B200 183359 MiB; batch 64 per rank; effective global batch 512.

Aligned/zero/shuffle main action losses and relative gains; object-delta RMS and active fraction; main delta gate mean/deviation and directional residual RMS; slot absolute cosine; positive and negative similarity margins; memory-only action loss; step time; GPU memory, utilization, and power.

R4 learned separated temporally matched object slots and made aligned memory useful to the memory-only decoder, but full-policy main action loss remained invariant to none, zero, and shuffle. R5 writes object-local temporal change directly into the final hidden-state residual. A raw-delta magnitude gate cannot be learned away, while a learned directional path preserves signed object dynamics. The terminal decision remains the matched main-policy causal-use gate.
